sections.heading: What Miggi can do
paragraphs: Explore ideas and pick up conversations where you left off. Miggi stores your history on your computer and works with the model you choose.
Keep topics separate
Work, study, or a personal project — each topic has its own room, conversation, and context.
Keep your history
Conversations and context live in Home, a folder you choose. The model receives the relevant part of your history, not all of it at once.
Switch models
You can change AI providers while keeping conversations in the same profile. Responses and available tools depend on the selected model.

sections.heading: Connect an AI model to chat
paragraphs: Miggi is free. You need your own OpenAI API key with available credits, or a compatible local model through Ollama. Cloud API usage is billed separately.

sections.heading: Try the alpha
paragraphs: A test version, not a stable release. For your first run, use a separate Home without personal data.
Do not bypass SmartScreen or disable Windows protection. Read the build limitations before installing.

sections.heading: Do I need an API key?
paragraphs: For cloud AI, you need a key from your chosen provider. API usage is billed separately at that provider’s rates. Enter the key in the app, not on this site.

sections.heading: Can I use it without a cloud model?
paragraphs: Yes, with Ollama and a compatible local model. Hardware requirements depend on the model. Search and other network tools still use the internet.

sections.heading: What data goes to the cloud?
paragraphs: With cloud AI, the provider receives your request, selected context, and attachments you allow. Local history storage does not mean every feature works offline. Back up important data.

sections.heading: How are updates installed?
paragraphs: Miggi checks the alpha channel automatically. Download and installation require your confirmation; Windows will ask for administrator rights. The TUF channel signature does not replace a Windows publisher signature. The full installed update cycle still needs testing; supported paths are listed in the release notes.
